paite: Huchi in David bel huai a apawtkhia ay pan Adullam kokhuk ah a-omta hi. Asanggamte leh apate inkote tengteng in azak un huai ah akiang ah ahohsuk uh.
heading: Siampute Thahna

paite: Lungkham peuhmah, leiba nei peuhmah leh lungkim lou peuhmahte akiang ah akikaikhawm uh. Huchi in aheutu un a-omta hi. Akiang ah mi zali hiamtak a-om uhi.
David bel huai a pan Moab gam a Mizpah ah ahoh hi. Moab kumpipa kiang ah, "Pathian in ahon hihsak ding thil ka theih masiah ka nu leh ka pate na kiang ah na om le uh," achi hi.
Moab kumpipa ma ah amaute api a; huchi in kokhuk a David a-om lai teng akiang ah a-om uhi.
Zawlnei Gad in David kiang ah, "Kokhuk ah om nilouh ke'n. Pawt inla Judah gam ah pai in," achi hi. Huchi in David apawt a, Hareth gammang ah alutta hi.
Saul in, "David leh akiang a omte amuta uh," chih ana za hi. Saul bel Gibeah a Ramah a tamarisk sing nuai ah teipi tawi in atu hi. Akim ah asikha tengteng adingh uhi.
Saul in akim a dingh asikhate kiang ah, "Nou Benjamin mite aw, ngaikhia un; Jesse tapa in loute leh grephuante hon pia in asepaih sangkhat heutu leh asepaih zakhat heutu in ahon bawl dia hia?

Na vek un na hon sawm ua, ka tapa in Jesse tapa kiang a thu akhun ka kiang a hihlang himhim na om kei uh. Ka tapa in ka sikha kei hon dou ding leh tuni nangawn a kei hon tang dia ahanthawn thu ka kiang a hihlang na om louh uh?" achi hi.
Huchi in Saul sikhate kiang a ding Edom mi Doeg in adawng a, "Jesse tapa Nob a Ahitub tapa Ahimelek kiang a, ahong lam ka mu hi.
Ama'n TOUPA adotsak a, nek ding apia a, Philistia mi Goliath namsau leng ape lai hi," achi hi.
Huchi in kumpipa'n Ahitub tapa Ahimelek leh Nod a siampu a pang apa inkote tengteng asamsak hi.
Saul in, "Nang, Ahitub tapa, na ngaikhia in," achi hi. Ama'n, "Ka toupa, hiai ah ka om," achi hi.
Saul in akiang ah, "Tanghou leh namsau na pia a, TOUPA bang dotsak a, tuni a kei hon dou ding leh hon tang dia bang ding a nang leh Jesse tapa in hon guksawm na hi ua?" achi hi.
Ahimelek in kumpipa adawng a, "Kumpipa makpa, na thumang, na inkuan sung ua mizahtakhuai David bang a muanhuai na sikhate tengteng lak ah kua a-om ua?
Amah a dia Pathian thu ka dotsak amasapen ahi a hia? Ahi kei. Kumpipa'n asikha hiam, ka pa inkote kuapeuh hon ngoh mahmah kei hen. Na sikha in hiai thu bangmah ka thei kei hi," achi hi.
Kumpipa'n, "Ahimelek, na sih ngeingei ding ahi, nang leh na pa inkote tengteng toh," achi hi.

Kumpipa'n akiang a dingh sepaihte kiang ah, "Kihei unla, TOUPA siampute that un, David lam a apan ua, taimang ahi chih thei napi a ka kiang a agen louh ziak un," achi hi. Himahleh kumpipa sikhate'n TOUPA siampute sual ding in khut azak nuam kei uhi.
Kumpipa'n Doeg kiang ah, "Nang kihei inla, siampute sual in,” achi hi. Edom mi Doeg akihei a, siampute asual a, huai ni in puanmalngat siampu puanak silh, mi sawmgiat-le-nga athat hi.
Nob, siampu khua namsau in asual a; numei leh pasal naupang leh nawi ne laite nangawn, bawngte, sabiltungte leh belamte toh namsau in asatlum hi.
Ahitub tapa Ahimelek tapate lak a khat, amin Abiathar ataikhia a, David kiang ah ataitung hi.
Abiathar in Saul in TOUPA siampute athah thu David ahilh hi.
David in Abiathar kiang ah, "Edom mi Doeg huai a, a-om ni mah in Saul ahilh ngeingei ding chih theisa in ka om hi. Na pa inkuan tengteng kei ziak a si ahi uh.
Nang ka kiang ah om inla, lau ke'n. Kei thah hon tumte'n nang leng thah ahon tum ding uh. Ka kiang ah om lechin na bit ding hi," achi hi.
